title: report_guard reads its helper modules from the stamped guard.d/<id>/ copy, not the flat hooks copies
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), 16:26 CST Nov 8; Merge after: #2321 (step hooks-home-lookups). #2321 adds route_match.py and reply_judge.py to the guard-set lists, so a stamped copy of each lands in guard.d/<id>/. But lint/report_guard.py puts HERE/../hooks first on sys.path (about lines 166, 885, 1358 and 1457), so it still reads the flat copies, which are not installed as one unit. Harm: a half-installed hooks folder can pair a new report_guard with an old helper. The builder recorded the gap in decision install-hooks-whole. Fix shape: report_guard prefers the stamped guard.d/<id>/ folder. Red case: with a stamped copy and a different flat copy, report_guard loads the stamped one. Filed as a fix step under the gap-gets-a-fix ruling (owner, #1516).
note: Lane session_013NEJL1YhjiXhaxqz8244Ge started 12:13 CST Nov 9 (coordinator). Done: b3f3d2614 and 90a46e0f1 on main (2026-11-09): report_guard reads the stamped guard.d copy first (lint/report_guard.py:182-208) (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 06:03 CST Nov 10).
